meta.note: full public sets, simple paired bootstrap over questions

threshold_80.basis: hard = clef-flash ref accuracy below 80%, easy = the rest

median_mean_refs.basis: median split on the mean of the clef-flash ref and clef (27B) ref accuracies

median_ex_boundary.basis: primary median split with the two tasks nearest the median boundary swapped (hardest easy task to hard, easiest hard task to easy)
